comment: Model B on all training conversations of the 15 pairs: 2 epochs (about 130 min at 1.3 s per step), effective batch 32 (4 x 8 accumulation) on ONE T4. With nn.DataParallel every micro-batch copies the 494M parameters to the second GPU and reduces the gradients back, which made a step take 2.33 s; one GPU avoids that copy. 256-subword windows, length-bucketed batches.
